name: jev-gate-router
description: Routes the main thread's effort and each subagent's model and effort with one TypeSafe Jev assessment; on by default, native on any doubt.

enabled.title: Enable the Router
enabled.description: Off registers no hook at all. Every request keeps its native model and effort.

routeSubagentModel.title: Route subagent models
routeSubagentModel.description: Choose the model of a subagent: an inheriting built-in (general-purpose, claude, Plan, Explore) that names none, or any Agent call that names one.

routeExplicitSpawnModel.title: Route named subagent models
routeExplicitSpawnModel.description: Also choose the model when the Agent call names one (model: "opus"): the name is treated as a default.

routeSubagentEffort.title: Route subagent effort
routeSubagentEffort.description: Set each subagent's reasoning effort from its task, on every request its loop makes.

routeMainEffort.title: Route main-thread effort
routeMainEffort.description: Choose the effort of the main thread's requests, per turn.

routeMainModel.title: Route main-thread model
routeMainModel.description: Choose the model of the main thread's requests, per turn. Enabled by default.

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Used only in the Authorization header of the assessment request. Blank reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY from the environment.

fastModel.title: Fast profile model
fastModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the fast profile.

standardModel.title: Standard profile model
standardModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the standard profile.

deepModel.title: Deep profile model
deepModel.description: Alias or exact model ID for the deep profile.

frontierModel.title: Frontier profile model
frontierModel.description: Exact model ID for the frontier profile. Blank leaves the profile unconfigured.

minUpgradeConfidence.title: Upgrade confidence floor
minUpgradeConfidence.description: Least probability, 0.5 to 1, that the work needs at least the stronger model or higher effort: Jev's answer mass at or above it.

minDowngradeConfidence.title: Downgrade confidence floor
minDowngradeConfidence.description: Least probability, 0.5 to 1, that the weaker model or lower effort is enough: Jev's answer mass at or below it.

timeoutMs.title: Preparation budget (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Total routing preparation budget, including host reads and Jev, 50 to 30000 ms. Past it the request runs natively.

logDecisions.title: Log decisions
logDecisions.description: Write one metadata-only line per decision to the debug log. Never task text or the key.

allowFable.title: Router: Allow automatic Fable selection
allowFable.description: Opt in to new automatic Fable model targets, including owned planners and workers. A manually selected root remains usable when off.
